- Crouch to find and pull the lever in the nearby fireplace

locations.title: Hidden Stairs
locations.description:
**Location:** In the ceiling on the second floor.

**Solution:**
- Press the button on the pillar after restoring power via the [Fusebox](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=438841)

locations.title: Shadow Puzzle (Eagle)
locations.description:
**Location:** Started by using the [Wooden Statuette](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=444756) on the pedestal. Using any other item unlocks the 'Nice Try' achievement.

**Solution:**
- Rotate the statuette until its shadow roughly matches the outline of an eagle in the painting, then press the 'OK' button.

locations.title: Incinerator Room Puzzle
locations.description:
**Location:** Inside the incinerator room - involves opening the chutes in the correct order to get the [Dissection Room Key](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=444782). Solution hinted at by the [Incinerator Room Memo](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=444780).

**Solution:**
- Open the chute at the far end (with a 'Tamara' tag inside)
- Open the third chute from the left (with a red handprint and 'Craig' tag on it)
- Open the far left chute (with a 'Travis' tag on it) - and get ready to fight!

locations.title: Shadow Puzzle (Numbers)
locations.description:
**Location:** Behind some bushes in the south-western corner of the yard.

**Solution:**
- Use the [Toy Axe](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=445277) on the pedestal and rotate it until it resembles the number 7. This will open the nearby [chest](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=445285).

locations.title: Shadow Puzzle (Spider)
locations.description:
**Location:** Started by using the [Stone Statuette](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=444861) on the pedestal. Using any other item unlocks the 'Nice Try' achievement.

**Solution:**
- Rotate the statuette until its shadow roughly matches the outline of an spider in the painting, then press the 'OK' button.

locations.title: Clock Puzzle
locations.description:
**Location:** On the bedside table.

**Solution:**
- Turn the clock's hands until the small hand points to 10 and the large hand points to 3.

locations.title: Attic Puzzle
locations.description:
**Location:** Inside the bedroom, a ladder waits just out of reach.

**Solution:**
- Examine the nearby [Trophy](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=445266) with a lampshade on it to find (and press) a button. This will lower the ladder.

locations.title: Shadow Puzzle (Executioner)
locations.description:
**Location:** In the middle of the attic.

**Solution:**
- Rotate the statuette that's already on the plinth until its shadow roughly matches the outline of the executioner, then press the 'OK' button.

locations.title: Birthday Cake
locations.description:
**Location:** Opposite the showers. Light it with the [Candle](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=445345) - but note it's not as easy as it sounds!

**Quick Solution (ignores several optional steps):**
- Grab the [Candle](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=445345) and approach the cake for the first time. This will turn on the lights.
- Turn on the [Stove](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=445350) and re-light the candle
- Burn through the [Rope Door](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=445348)
- Unlock the [Combination-Lock Door](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=445352) and grab the [Valve Handle](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=445353)
- Turn off the [Shower Pipe](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=445355)
- Re-light the candle with the [Stove](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=445350), then put it in the cake!
- Dispose of the [Time Bomb](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=445364) through a hole behind the [Wooden Board](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=445347)

locations.title: D-Series Arm
locations.description:
**Location:** Attached to a corpse at the end of the corridor.

**Used To:** Progress the story - after picking it up, you should return to [the trailer](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=444849) in the yard.

locations.description:
**Location:** Dropped by Marguerite upon her death.

- [Snake Door](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=444796)
- [Snake Door](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=444734)
- [Snake Door](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=444737)

locations.title: Keycard (Red)

**Location:** On top of a table in the workshop.

**Used To:** Unlock the [Keycard Door](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=444832) along with the [Keycard (Blue)](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=445284)

locations.title: Toy Axe
locations.description:
**Location:** On a lower shelf in the corner of the attic.

**Used To:** Solve the [Shadow Puzzle (Numbers)](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=444830), found behind some bushes in the south-west corner of the yard.

locations.title: Model Shotgun
locations.description:
**Location:** On an upper shelf in the corner of the attic.

**Used To:** Pull a switcheroo on the [M37 Shotgun](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=444731) in the main hall (or retrieve the [broken shotgun](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=444823) so you can [repair it](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?search=category:12405).)

locations.title: Keycard (Blue)
locations.description:
**Location:** Inside a dollhouse in the attic. Can only be grabbed after solving the [Shadow Puzzle (Executioner)](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=445283)


**Used To:** Unlock the [Keycard Door](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=444832) along with the [Keycard (Red)](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=444977)

locations.title: Battery
locations.description:
**Location:** On top of a barrel near the stairs.

**Used To:** Power up the [Console](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=445334).

locations.title: Candle
locations.description:
**Location:** Held by the creepy clown animatronic when you first enter the room.

**Used To:** View your surroundings and, ultimately, light the [Birthday Cake](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=445346).

locations.title: Balloon
locations.description:
**Location:** On the floor next to the dresser in a room filled with balloons.

**Used To:** Obtained the [Quill Pen](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=445360) once it's been [filled with gas](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=445349). Optional unless you're viewing the ["Happy Birthday"](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=445268) tape.

locations.title: Valve Handle
locations.description:
**Location:** On the wall behind the [Combination-Lock Door](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=445352).

**Used To:** Disable the [Shower Pipe](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=445355)

locations.title: Dirty Telescope
locations.description:
**Location:** Inside the toilet.

**Used To:** View shapes on the television. Equip the telescope and walk through the showers to clean it. Optional unless you're viewing the ["Happy Birthday"](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=445268) tape.

locations.title: Straw Doll
locations.description:
**Location:** Inside the [Combination-Lock Cabinet](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=445357).

**Used To:** Reveal a Dummy Finger when burned on the [Stove](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=445350). Optional unless you're viewing the ["Happy Birthday"](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=445268) tape.

locations.title: Dummy Finger
locations.description:
**Location:** Inside the [Straw Doll](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=445358), and revealed when burning it on the [Stove](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=445350).

**Used To:** Fix the [Clown Animatronic](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=445362)'s hand. Optional unless you're viewing the ["Happy Birthday"](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=445268) tape.

locations.title: Quill Pen
locations.description:
**Location:** Inside the [Balloon](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=445351), and can only be extracted by filling it with the [Gas Pipe](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=445349).

**Used To:** Give the [Clown Animatronic](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=445362) something to hold after fixing his hand with the [Dummy Finger](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=445359). Optional unless you're viewing the ["Happy Birthday"](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=445268) tape.

locations.title: Winding Key
locations.description:
**Location:** Inside a barrel in the same room as the cake.

**Used To:** Activate the [Clown Animatronic](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=445362). Optional unless you're viewing the ["Happy Birthday"](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=445268) tape.

locations.title: Time Bomb
locations.description:
**Location:** In the middle of the room after solving the [Birthday Cake](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=445346) puzzle.

**Used To:** Kill Ethan, unless you throw it through a hole behind the [Wooden Board](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=445347) - quickly!

locations.title: The Evil Within reference
locations.description: The painting of a figure with a bag over their head is remarkably similar to one featured prominently in The Evil Within, a game directed by Shinji Mikami. Mikami is best known for his work directing the original Resident Evil, its 2002 remake, and Resident Evil 4.

locations.title: "The Unveiled Abyss" by Clive R. O'Brian
locations.description: Inspecting the book in the box reveals its author is Clive R. O'Brian, a supporting character that acted as the head of the BSAA in Resident Evil: Revelations

locations.title: Report by Alyssa Ashcroft
locations.description:
The [Newspaper Article - Over 20 Missing](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=444723) was written by Alyssa Ashcroft, a playable character in Resident Evil Outbreak and Resident Evil Outbreak: File 2.

She was an investigative reporter from the Raccoon Press with skills in lockpicking that managed to survive the Raccoon City Incident.

Her daughter, Grace Ashcroft, joins the series as a playable character in Resident Evil 9: Requiem ([which we have a map for!](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-requiem/maps/world))

locations.title: Arklay Mountains painting
locations.description:
In the main hall, next to the [Centaur Door](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-7-biohazard/maps/baker-ranch?locationIds=438882), you'll find a painting titled "Arklay Mountains". 

This area was home to the Spencer Mansion, visited in the first Resident Evil, and a series of Umbrella facilities visited in Resident Evil 0.

locations.title: "Fighting Street"
locations.description: Alongside many other tongue-in-cheek books ("Insects", "Beautiful Home", "Unnerving Combat", etc), you can find a book on this shelf (and a few others in the game) titled 'Fighting Street'. This may be a nod to another Capcom game, "Street Fighter".

locations.title: Renovation Contract
locations.description:
A scrap of paper on the ground here reveals that the shadow puzzle in the main hall was built by Trevor & Chamberlain Construction. This is likely a reference to George Trevor, the architect behind the first Resident Evil game's Spencer Mansion, which was home to several puzzles and deadly traps in its own right. 

George and his wife died in the mansion sometime in the 1960's, so while this note being dated 1992 makes it unlikely that the Baker Estate was worked on by George personally, it seems his legacy has lived on.
